# Spain Cantabria Crop fields

Spain Cantabria field boundaries (2024) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from the source. License: CC-BY-NC-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cb/latest/es_cb.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cb/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4326; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: crop:code, geometry, admin_municipality_code, crop:name_en, collection, id, crop:name, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cb/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cb/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cb/collection.json
